feedback: The previous iteration's robot showed good completion and low errors on oval and s-bend tracks but struggled on the slalom track with off-track terminations and higher errors, mainly due to line loss events. The integrator had to compensate for limited sensor coverage and narrower wheel track, which affected turning stability and off-track tolerance. If the next race shows continued line loss events or off-track terminations on the slalom track, increase sensor size to 0.016 m and widen the wheel track and body width to 0.16 m to improve tape coverage and stability. If line loss events reduce but max error or steering oscillation remain high, adjust sensor positions to better cover tape edges and tune PID gains for smoother control. If the robot completes all tracks with low errors and minimal line loss, consider reducing sensor size to 0.012 m to save weight and improve responsiveness.
requested_changes: geometry.sensor_size to 0.016 based on reduced line loss in previous races with larger sensors
geometry.wheel_track and geometry.body_width to 0.16 based on improved turning stability and off-track tolerance
geometry.sensor_positions adjusted to maintain full tape coverage based on telemetry showing line loss at tape edges
